question.text: Under Regulation 292K of SEBI (ICDR) Regulations 2018, the draft fund-raising document for a Zero Coupon Zero Principal (ZCZP) issuance by a Not-for-Profit Organization must contain minimum disclosures across multiple heads. Which option lists the COMPLETE set of minimum-disclosure heads as per the regulation?

answer.text: Vision; Target Segment; Strategy; Governance; Management; Operations; Finance; Compliance; Credibility; Social Impact; Risks
Vision; Target Segment; Promoter Net Worth; Underwriting Arrangement; Credit Rating
Strategy; Cost of Borrowing; Debt Service Coverage; Asset Cover; Debenture Trustee
Target Segment; Secondary Market Liquidity Plan; Market-Maker Commitment; Price Band

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 292K lists the minimum disclosures an SSE must ensure in the issuance document as the eleven heads: Vision, Target Segment, Strategy, Governance, Management, Operations, Finance, Compliance, Credibility, Social Impact and Risks. ZCZPs carry no coupon and no principal redemption, so credit-rating, DSCR, asset-cover and price-band disclosures applicable to conventional debt are not part of the 292K scheme. The Trap: Options referencing credit rating, DSCR, asset cover, underwriting, market-maker and price band are drawn from mainstream debt or IPO disclosure regimes and do not apply to ZCZP because there is nothing to repay. A partial list of valid heads is also incorrect because the regulation specifies all eleven. Note: The full eleven-head checklist (including Management, Operations, Compliance and Credibility, which the partial list omits) is what the SSE expects in a 292K-compliant draft document.
